name: Just Domain.
description: Just Domain brings domain search into the chat. Its remote MCP server exposes one tool, search_domains: give it one or more domain names and it returns, for each, whether it's available, its first-year price, its renewal price, and — when available — a link to open in a browser and complete registration on justdomain.ai. It's read-only, so nothing is bought or charged inside the conversation; the assistant finds the name and hands back a ready-to-open link. No login, no setup, nothing to install. Works with any MCP-enabled assistant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Just Domain. to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Just Domain. to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.justdomain.ai/.

_published_faq.name: Is Just Domain. MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Just Domain. scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Just Domain. MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Just Domain. provides these MCP tools: search_domains.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Just Domain.?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Just Domain. in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Just Domain. MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Just Domain. does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Just Domain. is developed by Just Domain.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
